notes.title: RUN TO THE CURE
notes.content:
UPDATE NOTES

NOTICE!
THE FIRST VERSION OF THE GAME CALLED KEEP RUNNING IS STILL AVAILABLE, BUT HIS CHARACTER HAS BEEN CHANGED TEMPORARILY TO REDUCE FRUSTRATION ON GAMEPLAY

THE KEEP RUNNING 2 GAMEPLAY IS STILL AVAILABLE!

RELEASES

Inserted the new mode "RUN TO THE CURE" still in BETA (Bugs can occur), all feedback will be welcome.

History

This new mode called  KEEP RUNNING RUN TO THE CURE  will put you in the skin of the scientist Kameron. Kameron is search for the cure to the pandemic that has haunted us for almost 1 year, but for that he must arrive to the laboratory first and begin his hard work to find the cure.

At the stage the disease is in, Kameron represents only part of the 40% of the world's remaining population. His skills as a scientist are not very good, but he is one of the few scientists left in the city of Toonsville. When Kameron had already exhausted his efforts and resources to find a cure when he was on the verge of insanity, here's an idea of ​​how to stop the virus.

But nothing in life is easy, and Kameron knew he would be too much risk chances by going out into the world, so he decided to grab his protective suit to start his journey to the cure. COVID-20, which is the evolution of COVID-19, in addition to its already known symptoms, it causes hallucinations, bleeding coughs, strong heart rhythm, and finally death. COVID-20 is evolving on a large scale, becoming stronger than any other virus, reaching the point where it is no longer microscopic and can be seen with the naked eye. This is a worldwide crisis and Kameron will need all the help needed to fight this virus.

Objective

Ajude Kameron a chegar até seu laboratório que fica a 1KM de distancia do seu refúgio.

notes.title: HAS ARRIVED !! KEEP RUNNNING 2.0 UPDATE IN BETA PLAY AND TRY NOW !!!
notes.content:
Hello born runner, I come to show you the latest update of my Keep Running game, I've been studying hard about developing games, and this update is just the tip of what's to come, I decided to spice up this new mode is  FREE, because I am grateful for those who gave feedback, thus contributing so that I could make improvements and think of a new game mode. As you may have seen in the upper case letters, this update is in phase  BETA  so bugs may occur during gameplay, if so, you can immediately let me know that I will be ready to fix it.

  Also if you have ideas for contributing to the game, such as items, or some kind of enhancement, post it in the comments because I read them all = D  

  STORY  

So basically in this new mode you control a boy named Kai, who woke up in a hospital. Not knowing what to do and scared, Kai starts to run desperately, but after some time running he realizes that the hospital corridor seems endless. With no choice to think, stop running or rest Kai keeps running for his life, while a demon behind is about to kill him for some reason.

  Purpose and Tips  

[olist]
 Run and dodge the hospital objects that come your way as they will push you towards the demon.
 The devil can only catch you if you are in the same direction line as him.
 Do not let objects push you because if dropped is left behind it will die.
[/olist]

  CHANGES AND UPDATES  

Now you can:
[olist]
 Choose a resolution from the home screen options menu.
 Select the "FULL SCREEN" option.
 Move the graphics (If your pc chokes put on the bottom)
[/olist]

notes.title: UPDATES - 19/06/2018
notes.content:
Hello for everyone, I am very thankful by the feedbacks done on the community, many people are helping me with bugs and improvements that I can make.So first of all, THANK YOU VERY MUCH GUYS, YOU ARE AWESOME.

Well I made some improves, about the dificulty, and I fixed some bugs, follow bellow the changes:


BUG FIXES:

The bug where you pass through the floor when the box push you but you don't die.

A bug that your progress dont have the correct progress and the counter of clocks and boots not reset when you die..

The boots have no fall with the correct frequency, and clocks end up take the place and fall on the place of boots.

IMPROVEMENTS:

The difficulty be more precise, when you reach on determined point of game

The boosters are falling with a new frequency, and getting more fast while you advance and gain more points.

Well, is that, I hope you enjoy, comment and notify me if you see any bug, or have ideas to improve the game, thanks for attention guys you are awesome... and KEEP RUNNING.
